sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor form, winless in their last five outings and languishing second-from-bottom with just 4 points from 10 games, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match with title-race implications, as they sit just 2 points behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in strong recent form, host Eccleshall in a clash between mid-table contenders. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town, fifth on 17 points, face Foley Meir in a fixture between upper-mid-table sides. Elsewhere, Barnton host Shawbury United (both struggling for consistency), Market Drayton Town travel to high-flying New Mills, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle of the bottom sides, Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town (who are pointless and winless).
